experiments.title: Identify controller-induced saturation
experiments.design: Matched inputs and independent recorded RNG streams; compare frozen controls, existing base control, controller-only surrogate, and bounded shadow interventions. Never change physical execution authority.
experiments.success_interpretation: Establish which dynamics are substrate-driven versus controller-induced.
experiments.falsifier: The apparent operating regime disappears or task performance is unchanged when the substrate is ablated.
guards: Do not equate zero optional nudges with zero base control.
Do not loosen safety gates merely to create exposure.

experiments.title: Semantic input separation
experiments.design: Retain moment controls but add an identity-bearing channel. Test permutation collisions, semantic-neighbor preservation, and independently labeled delayed recall.
experiments.success_interpretation: The chosen channel preserves distinctions needed by the task, not every possible input distinction.
experiments.falsifier: Different required outputs remain indistinguishable after encoding.
guards: Use the same encoder for all computational baselines.
Keep synthetic exact counterexamples distinct from natural-embedding benchmarks.

experiments.title: Graph-aware independent court
experiments.design: Add per-obligation checking, source deduplication, dependency reachability, and critical-constraint vetoes. Test edge rewiring, evidence disconnection, redundant-node padding, and contradiction persistence.
experiments.success_interpretation: Acceptance depends on causal evidence relationships and mandatory constraints, not just aggregate scores.
experiments.falsifier: An unresolved mandatory contradiction can still be diluted by unrelated supported nodes.
guards: Keep manifold replay independent from correctness labels.
Do not treat demo scoring metrics as calibrated probabilities.

experiments.title: Time-normalized primitive verification
experiments.design: Run equal simulated-time and equal readout-time horizons across dt=0.12,0.08,0.04,0.02; preserve versioned equations. Verify postconditions in addition to residual/flux thresholds.
experiments.success_interpretation: A robust completion event and a resource-bounded state transition emerge across timestep refinement.
experiments.falsifier: The event tracks step count, disappears under refinement, or merely reflects loss of signal.
guards: Predicted dt=0.04 halt steps are not observations.

experiments.title: Historical damping-boundary audit
experiments.design: Versioned comparison of the retained discrete update with exponential/positivity-preserving damping at equal physical time, spanning multiple timesteps and topology changes.
experiments.success_interpretation: Separate genuine model regimes from the zero/clamp of a numerical update.
experiments.falsifier: The proposed universal critical value moves as 1/(0.1*dt).
guards: Do not silently replace the intended discrete model.
Do not declare topology invariance alone to be evidence of a physical constant.

experiments.title: Cross-repository delayed-recall/conflict-routing benchmark
experiments.design: Independent task generator; identity-preserving input; SOL storage/routing/readout; frozen versus adaptive Frontier; live Lens packets and obligation checks; SOL-Edge eligibility only. Compare finite-state/DAG, graph diffusion, conventional reservoir, and controller/substrate ablations.
experiments.success_interpretation: A named practical advantage at matched correctness and budget, including controller and verifier overhead.
experiments.falsifier: Simple baselines match performance at lower cost or benefit disappears on held-out seeds/tasks.
guards: Do not substitute simulation time for speed or simulated mass for electrical energy.
No claim of physical execution authorization from eligibility.

experiments.title: Controlled macrostate closure
experiments.design: Create distinct microstates sharing a candidate macrostate. Apply identical permitted inputs/interventions and compare next-macrostate distributions at a specified time horizon, including perturbations and held-out states.
experiments.success_interpretation: The abstraction is sufficiently predictive under legal interventions to serve as a reusable computational operator.
experiments.falsifier: Hidden microstate variables change outputs materially despite identical macrostate and action.
guards: Include required phase, elapsed time, and resource reserve in the abstraction.
Predictive agreement is not automatically a proof of causal emergence under every formalism.
